title: The Forfeit Pinnace
logline: A compulsive gambler hires a mercenary to intercept and destroy their own championship racing yacht before a high-stakes rematch, desperate to remove the collateral feeding their relapse.

roles.description: A former orbital racing champion swearing off the tables; sweating, superstitious, terrified of his own impulses.
Holds the betting book on the seasonal circuit; jovial, predatory, knows the gambler cannot resist one more wager.
Flies the gambler's gilded racing pinnace; unpaid for six months and desperate to collect back wages.
A sleek, gold-leafed custom racing vessel stripped of shields to shave mass for the drag circuits.
The station's opulent betting promenade overlooking the racing lanes.
Finances local high-roller challenges and underwrites racing purse loans.

public_situation: Promoters in {system} announce an unscheduled high-stakes exhibition duel between the veteran champion's gilded yacht and syndicate contenders.
private_truth: The champion knows he will bet his last organ if the yacht enters the starting gate, and is paying an outsider to blow it up before he can step aboard.

beats.public_change: Odds boards at the concourse light up with heavy wagers against the champion's uncrewed vessel.

missions.reason: He needs a military-spec transponder beacon purchased and delivered to his locker so he can broadcast the yacht's private slipway coordinates.
missions.private_fact: He already emptied his daughter's flight academy fund to place an opening bet on his own destruction.

beats.public_change: The racing yacht unmoors ahead of schedule and darts toward the inner planetary markers.

missions.reason: The bookmaker detects erratic engine telemetry from the yacht and needs a pilot to scan its telemetry to confirm whether it is carrying illegal fuel additives.
missions.private_fact: The bookmaker lent the skipper money to hijack the ship if the champion tried to back out of the purse race.

beats.public_change: The yacht cuts power near the outer asteroid ring, broadcasting an open challenge hail across commercial bands.

missions.reason: He is paying the pilot to engage and destroy the yacht in deep space before it reaches the official starting line at the concourse.
missions.private_fact: The hired skipper hails mid-fight offering to surrender the yacht's antique gold drive manifold if the pilot spares the hull.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the racing yacht before the race begins.
resolutions.summary: {role:racing_yacht} burns in deep space. With his collateral destroyed, {role:compulsive_gambler} forfeits the race and is forced into permanent retirement.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary blew a famous champion's gold-plated racer to scrap right before the betting closed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the skipper's offer in the comms reversal.
resolutions.summary: {role:hired_skipper} escapes with the stripped racer into deep space, leaving {role:compulsive_gambler} on the hook for syndicate default penalties.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot took a cut of a champion's custom drive core while his crew jumped ship.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the initial purchase or never takes the contract.
resolutions.summary: {role:wager_syndicate} seizes {role:racing_yacht} when the entry fees lapse, auctioning the hull and leaving {role:compulsive_gambler} penniless on the concourse.

loose_threads.detail: The bookmaker casually reveals that eighty percent of the circuit's registered racers carry mortgages held by the exact same consortium.
The racing yacht's engine casing has an older registration number hastily polished away beneath fresh gilt enamel.

radio_hooks: Betting closed abruptly on {system} exhibition race following mysterious telemetry dropout.
Promoters offer finder's fee for {role:racing_yacht} after unscheduled burn toward the asteroid belt.
Pundits debate whether veteran champion will appear at the start line or forfeit by absence.

voice_direction.compulsive_gambler: Breathless, manic cadence with superstitious mutterings. Constantly shifts between bragging about past victories and begging for help.
voice_direction.syndicate_bookie: Unctuous, hearty melodic delivery. Feigns total sympathy while rattling off compound interest figures.
voice_direction.hired_skipper: Flat, exhausted gravel voice. Speaks like someone whose paycheck has bounced six consecutive times.
